content.title: Roberto Sanchez
content.text: Roberto Sanchez is currently recurring in the Netflix series Running Point as Stephen Ramirez, and in the upcoming Apple TV+ series Cape Fear as Ruben Ramirez, opposite Javier Bardem and Amy Adams.He recently appeared in recurring roles on BMF as "Loco," Palm Royale as "Pinky," and Dexter: Original Sin as Tony Ferrer.The Cuban actor also wrote the story for the feature film "72 Hours," an action crime-thriller developed for the big screen by Christian Sesma and Sean Crayne. The film will co-star Sam Trammell (True Blood) and Cam Gigandet (The O.C.).Sanchez is known for memorable roles on hit television series including The Resident, The Family Business, S.W.A.T., MacGyver, Law & Order: Special Victims Unit, Chicago P.D., and Queen of the South, among more than 130 film and television projects. His breakout role came in 2 Fast 2 Furious, directed by John Singleton, opposite Eva Mendes and Paul Walker.As a director, Sanchez’s films "The Terms of Us" and "Heroes" were award-winning festival favorites. The Terms of Us later secured distribution on ShortsTV, while Heroes is currently being developed into a television pilot.In 2016, he received an Imagen Award nomination for Best Actor for his lead performance in the film Lake Los Angeles.TRIVIAServed in the U.S. Navy during Gulf War and competed professionally in the European League as a Naval basketball player.Also worked as a successful print model.
